note: Turkey's national spirits. The ones with `start` describe the situation on 1 January 2000 and cite sources. Values are gameplay estimates.

spirits.name: Fragile public finances
spirits.description: Large budget deficits are financed by high-interest bonds held by the banks; the IMF lends to Turkey in late 2000 and a crisis breaks out in February 2001.

spirits.name: EU candidate
spirits.description: The European Union recognised Turkey as a candidate on 12 December 1999 at Helsinki.

source.title: Wikipedia: Accession of Turkey to the European Union

spirits.name: PKK insurgency
spirits.description: An insurgency by the Kurdistan Workers' Party in the south-east, with ceasefires from time to time.

spirits.name: Conscription
spirits.description: Military service is compulsory for male citizens.

spirits.name: A stable lira
spirits.description: Inflation is down and a new lira has replaced the old one.

spirits.name: National defence industry
spirits.description: Drones, warships and armoured vehicles made at home.

spirits.name: Presidential system
spirits.description: An executive presidency without a prime minister.

spirits.name: Earthquake damage
spirits.description: Cities in the south-east were destroyed by the earthquakes of February 2023.
